reviews.t: Leather Hair Slide (or Hair Pencil,  Hair Pin, Hair Pencil Pin)
reviews.x: I have THICK hair that goes nearly down to my waist.  So it can be pretty darn heavy.  I got the Hair Slide yesterday. As soon as I got it, I took down my elastic tied ponytail and replaced it with the slide. It lasted the rest of the night.  The way I have always done it was the taken a top section of hair and cinched it in the back; in this case with the slide. I gather the hair as if I was going to use the elastic BUT I make sure that when I am placing the stick through, that I get a little o

reviews.t: Looks perfect. Feels a little cheap
reviews.x: $5.72 is what I paid for this little gem. Looks perfect. Feels a little cheap, but then it is.  I have pretty fine hair and at 50plus years old it's getting thin. If anyone is having a problem with using this on thin hair there is a trick to it.  I wore these in the seventies. Comb your hair back to the nape of neck and hold it like you're making a ponytail and twist it and then fold it up against the back of your head and apply the leather piece and fasten with stick. The stick can be scraped a

I had one of these back in the 70's. Thought I would check to see if they were still out there and lo and behold, they were! I'm thrilled! The are perfect for a loose pony or to put it up real quick. I love it! Thanks for keeping them available for us old hippie chicks!

I have a lot of very long (waist length) hair.  The majority of clips and pins will not fit or hold my hair in a single ponytail, much less when it's pulled into a bun.  This one did.  Granted the fit is a bit tight for me, but it should fit comfortably for most people.

Again I ordered the product and never received it though money was taken.  I contacted Amazon and Amazon directed me to the Company.  I've contacted the Company but have never heard back.  Alison Staley

reviews.t: Nice hair pin and great customer service!
reviews.x: Years ago I had a leather hair pin like this one and decided to try to find it online. I was happy to find this pin and was very pleased with the flexibility in the leather and the color (black).  I was however unhappy with the stick pin, it had cracked and it stuck into my head.  I contacted the sellers and they immediately mailed me a replacement.  Overall I was happy with the product and the customer service.

The item was sent on time, right color, but it is to small to put my hair up. So for that reason I won't order again. Plus I ordered a second leather hair pencil pin from this same company and they didn't send the correct hair pencil pin. I would like to know how large the hair pin would be before I purchase.
Nicely made of leather, & attractive.  The hairstick broke on my fourth use.  Go easy on it.

I have a similar leather barrette like this from way back in my flower child days but it has gotten stretched, some dog or cat must have chewed on it too, so I thought it was time to replace it.  This one, I got a red one, is very nice and I hope it'll last as long as my past one.
Even for the low price, the quality is very poor. The brown version comes with a black stick. I wouldn't have even bothered ordering it if that had been clear in the product description.

The leather piece is beautiful and I love it but the wooden pins are flimsey and one broke the first day I wore it. Fortunately I had purchased two so I had a back up pin and was still able to wear it. But if/when that one breaks then I am done, I will not reorder after that happens. Maybe they should use a metal pin with a dull point to avoid that problem.

This is not made of leather unless you consider approximately a micron of leather layered over foam as a leather product. Cheaply made, would be overpriced at $1.99. The pin is wood, though. I guess I need to dig around and find my REAL leather hair holders from the 60s. The pin will be useful on them, at least.

YEP...5!! I bought 1 of these barrettes and fell in love with it so I went back and bought 4 more. I have fine shoulder length hair and this barrette holds my hair in an updo or in a traditional ponytail. It is sturdy and well made. I don’t have a lot of luck with hair clips but this one seems to be magic.

This will be great when I cut a few inches off my hair but as it is now this seems to be to small to hold my hair up in place.  I plan on using it in the future after a hair cut.  Beautifully crafted and quality product.
Really like this hair clip. Very fashionable. My hair is fine, so I use a plain barrette to secure my hair and then put this clip over it. The clip I received is leather.
I like that it’s reversible. I use it mostly on the other side for work since it’s black and then use ito on the red side for a pop of color. Very good quality.
I ordered two of these because they reminded me of some I had years ago. They are very nice and hold your hair nice and tight.

reviews.t: the 70's are back and I am happy!
reviews.x: I love it, but I am wondering if they have a longer one to hold more hair..
If you have long thick hair this will not work for you.
Love these, remember them back when I was younger.

Wasn't sure how I was going to like the Pencil Pin but I love it!  I have got many compliments on them.  So glad I tried them. They are perfect for me.  I got several colors, the leather fits nicely over my hair and the "pencil" isn't overly long, so it looks perfect when I wear this.  Try it...you'll like it!

These were popular in the 70's. Always wanted one, but I was too young. Pleasantly surprised by this product! I have a ton of hair and it's down to my waist. This holds my hair perfectly. Saw some reviews saying it was too small. Not sure if they actually tried it.

I love this hair clip! I have thin, very fine hair so it's hard to find something that will hold it up off my neck without giving me a headache. This clip is like the ones I wore back in my flower child/hippie days and is pretty, as well as efficient. I love it!

It was cute.  It slid right out of my hair, so I gave it to my daughter. I couldn’t return it because the company wanted the still attached price tag. It would  have been nice if it HAD ARRIVED with an attached price tag. Won’t order from them again.

reviews.t: Hill top is much better quality
reviews.x: I sent an email to Bohemian with a picture of hair leather pieces from Hilltop. Bohemian was much smaller and thinner than Hilltop and was the same price. Me. Chong sent an email back saying he would pass the information on to his staff.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the hair slide attractive and well made, with several praising the leather quality and craftsmanship.
A common complaint is that the wooden hairstick/pin is flimsy and breaks easily, sometimes on the first or fourth use.
Several reviewers say the slide is too small to hold their hair, especially those with long or thick hair.
Some reviewers feel the product looks or feels cheap relative to its price, with one disputing that it is real leather.
Reviewers with fine or thin hair report the slide holds their hair well in ponytails and updos.
